acceptance_fixed.diagnostic_ci95: Retain CI95 coverage and exact CP95; separately flag definite undercoverage if CP95 upper <0.95. Operational99% interval is a new, named, stricter interval, never evidence that nominal95% has calibrated.
acceptance_fixed.failure_rule: FWER CP95 lower>0.05 or operational CI99 coverage CP95 upper<0.95 is failure; any confidence-bound criterion not established is inconclusive. Retain all results. No tolerance widening.
acceptance_fixed.operational_ci99_coverage_demonstrated_i: CP95 lower >=0.95 for CI99 MSE difference AND CI99 relative aggregate RMSE gain
acceptance_fixed.overall_claim: Conditional scope admission for the tested five one-panel DGPs and exact R10/T768/B8191/HAC48/block32/reference49999/alpha.025 if every prespecified bound passes. Never unconditional market validation, four-panel joint MC proof, actual-data sizing or R3 accreditation.
acceptance_fixed.power_target_demonstrated_only_if: CP95 lower >=0.90 for EVERY rival complete gate under the prespecified strong alternative; jointpower reported; no power claim for 3% alternative

benchmark_before_plan: Preserved pre-V3 deterministic native benchmark0.577CPU seconds/analyze at B8191/T768/m20/HAC48. Predict1477CPU for2560 replicates plus fixed references/reporting within2000CPU. This is an estimate, not observed consumption.
budget_rule: One process CPU clock includes deterministic fixed-b precomputation and all four threads. Stop starting new replicates at1968CPU seconds, reserving32CPU seconds for at most four inflight analyses; retain every completed row and mark incomplete if fewer than512 per scenario. No outcome-dependent extra sampling.
coverage: Report real CI95 and CI99 separately. Operational interval is explicitly CI99, studentized stationary bootstrap (log-MSE-ratio delta studentization for gain). Validate its actual coverage against >=0.95 with exact CP95 lower bound; never relabel it CI95 or hide diagnostic CI95 failures. Prespecified rival0, each scenario.
data_generator: Stationary bounded AR innovations after burn-in 300; common and idiosyncratic cross-rival differences; moving average for overlap scenario; exogenous lagged AR instrument independent of loss differences; losses positive, square roots used as predictions against y=0; fixed seed offsets cancel in differences. Strong alternative is deliberately large and does not establish power at 3% gain.
family: 120 absolute-tail two-sided p-values (count+1)/(reps+1): 20 rivals x 3 methods x EPA/practical; Holm across all120. Every method exposes MC count/reps/rule. Shared fixed-b reference draw seed independent of temporal synthetic datasets.
four_panel_application_note: Monte Carlo studies one complete temporal120 family, not four joint panels. Application to four admitted real panels is conditional on each panel meeting the stationary/FCLT/predictable-instrument assumptions. Global Holm180 over additional-panel EPA p-values is a mathematical strong-FWER adjustment when those marginal p-values are super-uniform; it requires no panel independence, but these five finite simulations do not establish super-uniformity for all markets or prove joint four-panel validity. Full80contrast power and joint conditional empirical-DGP power are separate genuine-data computations. No copies of one-panel ledger count as four-panel simulations.
fwer_event: Any Holm-adjusted p<.025 among exact null contrasts and all three methods, either direction. FWER target remains<=.05 with exactCP95upper; also report false directional superiority.
gate: All six adjustedp<.025, positive EPA/practical means, historical mean seedRMSE favorable,effect>=.2,CI95MSElower>0,CI99MSElower>0,CI99gainlower>margin; all20rivals forjoint gate.
implementation_identity: Source hashes for statistics.py, native C++ kernel, runner, tests and this plan must be frozen before simulation. Native is exact arithmetic acceleration of numpy algorithm; no RNG/decisions in native kernel.
power: Per-rival complete statistical gate and joint all-20 gate; report worst per-rival power with CP95 interval; target 0.90; only large simulated alternative covered
purpose: A new independent, bounded conditional validation of the stricter V4 operational decision alpha=.025 with unchanged V3 statistics/references/kernel and CI99. No market claims. No pooling with V3.
revision_reason: V3 complete ledger produced FWER and some operational-CI coverage confidence bounds that were inconclusive. Operational alpha is tightened to .025 while the original FWER<=.05 and CI99 coverage>=.95 validation criteria are unchanged. Independent seeds and fixed N512 per scenario were chosen before V4 observations.
